neighbours.label: obligation: the verb slot after 'have to' / 'must' (something is required of someone)
fire: After the storm, the residents will have to rebuild most of the fences themselves.
Listed firms must file audited accounts with the regulator every single year.
When the babysitter cancels, we have to take the kids to the office with us.
Applicants must submit two references before the interview can be scheduled.
Because the bridge closed, the drivers had to detour through the mountain pass.
Every pilot must complete a medical exam before flying passengers again.
Since the printer broke, I have to copy all the forms by hand tonight.
New tenants must pay the deposit before they receive the keys.
quiet: After the storm, the residents will want to rebuild most of the fences themselves.
Listed firms often file audited accounts with the regulator every single year.
When the babysitter cancels, we like to take the kids to the office with us.
Applicants usually submit two references before the interview is scheduled.
Because the bridge closed, the drivers chose a detour through the mountain pass.
Every pilot enjoys a short break before flying passengers again.
Since the printer broke, I decided to copy all the forms by hand tonight.
New tenants often pay the deposit before they receive the keys.

notes: Top: ' to' after have x6, must, measure. Opposite pole: 'a single item suffices'.
